headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 7, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. In other action, the New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6, while the Cincinnati Reds fell short in a 5-3 loss to the Washington Nationals.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays), who was placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. Other notable injuries include Cole Wilcox (Seattle Mariners) with a left oblique strain, Joe Ryan (Minnesota Twins) with a left glute strain, and Luis Urías (Toronto Blue Jays) with a right quad strain.

The Kansas City Royals made a notable trade, acquiring Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas. Additionally, the Miami Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Angels Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Athletics 6-5 in a closely contested game. Brian Serven led the Athletics' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6, securing a decisive win. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, going 2-for-4 with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Brewers Take Down Pirates 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 5-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, ending their opponent's chances. Gary Sánchez led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Aaron Ashby pitched a strong 1.0 inning in relief for the Brewers.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with multiple players contributing to the win. A.J. Ewing and Carson Benge led the Mets' offense, while Bryan Reynolds and Nick Gonzales had notable performances for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Nation's Capital**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, handing them their latest loss. Impact players for the Reds included Elly De La Cruz, Eugenio Suárez, Matt McLain, Daylen Lile, and Blake Dunn, while Cade Cavalli stood out for the winning Nationals.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's status has been updated.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade. Berry joins the Royals after being previously traded from the Miami Marlins.
